dpia.title: Appointment scheduling with an AI assistant

facts.text: Patients book and change appointments through a chat assistant on the clinic website.
The assistant reads the patient's previous appointment types (no clinical notes).
About 4,000 patients per month use the booking service.

criteria.assessment: Present: AI assistant. Considered together with the other criteria, not on its own.

criteria.criterion: Data subjects who may be vulnerable
criteria.assessment: To be confirmed: patients of all ages.

screening.outcome: Impact assessment to be carried out. Decision by the controller, recorded 2026-09-01.
screening.note: Using AI does not by itself make an impact assessment mandatory: the decision rests on the facts and criteria assessed.

observations.observation: The data flows to the AI provider are not described.
observations.informationRequired: Diagram of data flows, including where prompts are stored.
observations.recommendation: Complete section 2 with the flows and storage locations.

observations.observation: No human review of appointments suggested by the assistant.
observations.recommendation: A person reviews every suggested appointment before confirmation.

observations.observation: Retention period of chat transcripts not defined.
observations.recommendation: Define and document the retention period.

dpoReport.summary: Proceed only with human review of suggested appointments and a defined retention period.

controllerResponse.text: Human review accepted. Retention period to be defined after a pilot.

committedMeasures: Human review of every suggested appointment (O-2)
Retention period defined after a three-month pilot (O-3)

projectDecision.text: Go ahead with a three-month pilot at the main clinic.
projectDecision.reasons: The controller wants usage data from the pilot before fixing the retention period.
projectDecision.disagreement: The DPO maintains that the retention period should be defined before processing starts.
